title: alchemilla tephroserica
intro: Alchemilla tephroserica, commonly known as the alpine lady's mantle, is a flowering plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is traditionally used to support women's health, particularly in addressing menstrual disorders and menopausal symptoms, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla tephroserica are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the uterine tissues, thereby reducing menstrual cramps and heavy bleeding. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
